chars.AZIZ: AZIZ: a cheerful Moroccan man (42), short black hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow short-sleeve shirt and a grey tailor's apron with a measuring tape around his neck
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a Moroccan woman (38) wearing a teal hijab and a long burgundy djellaba, small gold earrings
chars.BOUCHRA: BOUCHRA: a plump flirtatious Moroccan vegetable seller in her late forties, bold red lipstick, heavy eyeliner, leopard-print headscarf, bright pink cardigan, many gold bangles

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: At a colourful vegetable stall in a busy Moroccan neighbourhood souk in Casablanca, BOUCHRA leans over crates of tomatoes and peppers handing AZIZ a full bag with a cheeky wink and a big smile, AZIZ stands stiff and awkward, smiling nervously and leaning back, comic tension

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same souk vegetable stall in daylight, AZIZ proudly introduces his WIFE to BOUCHRA, BOUCHRA smiles sweetly while looking only at AZIZ, the WIFE holds a basket and studies BOUCHRA with raised eyebrows

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: AZIZ and his WIFE walk away from the stall down a narrow souk alley carrying vegetable bags, the WIFE frowns and glances back suspiciously over her shoulder while whispering to AZIZ, AZIZ looks surprised

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In a simple Moroccan living room with a low sedari sofa and a tea tray, AZIZ laughs and waves his hand dismissively to reassure his WIFE, who sits with crossed arms, still unconvinced

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside a busy Moroccan sewing workshop full of sewing machines and fabric rolls, AZIZ answers his ringing phone with a casual smile, a big calendar on the wall behind him

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: BOUCHRA at home in a cosy Moroccan salon, lying back on a sofa twirling her hair, holding the phone to her ear with a teasing grin, a basket of vegetables beside her

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In the sewing workshop, AZIZ freezes with the phone at his ear, eyes wide and mouth open in shock, a coworker in the blurred background

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of AZIZ in the workshop, he pulls the phone away from his ear and stares at the screen in disbelief, sweat drop on his forehead

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: BOUCHRA stands in the doorway of her Moroccan house at dusk holding her phone, smiling slyly with one eyebrow raised as if waiting for someone, warm light behind her, mysterious atmosphere
